text.en:
Establishment of Asset Disposition Program (ADP) for
the DOTC/ATO - There is hereby created an Asset Disposition Program for the
DOTC / ATO. Such program shall be managed by an inter-agency task force
under the direction of the DOTC, and shall be composed of:
Undersecretary for Air Section/Staff Services
Department of Transportation and Communications
Vice-Chairman:
Assistant Secretary
Air Transportation Office

Representative from the Department of Finance
Representative from the Department of Justice
Representative from the Department of Budget and Management
Head of the Local Government Unit concerned
The representatives from the national
aforementioned must at least be an Assistant Secretary.
government agencies
Coverage. The ADP established under this Order shall have
specific responsibilities over the disposition of the existing Iloilo Airport.
Function and Authority of the ADP. The ADP shall study
and evaluate the plan of action and handle the process for the sale or disposition
of the existing Iloilo Airport.
Utilization of Proceeds. The proceeds of the sale or
disposition of the existing Iloilo airport/site shall be utilized in accordance with
applicable laws and regulations and following the guidelines of the Department
Term of ADP - The ADP shall continue to exist until the
purpose for which it was created has been achieved.
immediately.
Effectivity -
This Executive Order shall take effect
Two Thousand and Four.
Done, in the City of Manila this 17th day of Feb. in the year of Our Lord,
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
